Write the list of files left out of the snapshot into self_check. (3) Analyse every failure with evidence; a failure is acceptable only if proven not caused by this work; a test that passes and fails by turns is a defect (say so, do not rerun until green). (4) Say how long the team-web spec took on the runner against the local ~34 s, against the question line of 42000 ms (decisions/0113 О9, О22; if it is longer, say so plainly: ORCH must ask the owner) and against the limit of 70000 ms of criterion 8; the other three spec files against their budgets; and whether Chrome on ubuntu-24.04 accepted `--use-mock-keychain` with no new console line or failure (0113 О1). Compare the local and the GitHub totals with the CI limit of 30 minutes (watch value about 25 minutes) and state the margin. PASS only if both runs are green or every failure is proven not caused by this work; otherwise FAIL.

SAFETY: no step of yours starts the team server, the engine, a team command, Pixel Office or its hook outside the check command; never set SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS; never start the real `claude` program; a command denied by the permission check is not done another way. Do not edit the project (only this handoff), do not commit to any branch other than the temporary ci/ branch, do not push to main, no tags. The Mac has crashed under load before: one heavy job at a time. The handoff holds no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner.
